Dashboard.title: Overview of your engineering metrics
Dashboard.activeDevelopersDescription: Developers with activity data in the selected period.
Dashboard.totalCommitsDescription: Commits in the selected project, branch, and period.
Dashboard.totalMrsDescription: Merge requests merged in the selected period.
Dashboard.totalIssuesDescription: Issues created in the selected period.
Dashboard.bugsFoundDescription: Bug issues reported in the selected period.

metricScoring.rule: Scoring: {threshold}. Values between the thresholds are converted linearly to 0–100.
metricScoring.projectOnlyRule: Scoring (project only): {threshold}. Values between the thresholds are converted linearly to 0–100. In individual views, this is reference-only and excluded from scoring.
metricScoring.higherIsBetter: 0 below the lower bound; 100 above the upper bound
metricScoring.lowerIsBetter: 100 below the lower bound; 0 above the upper bound
metricScoring.referenceOnly: Scoring: reference-only (not used in metric or dimension score calculations)

metricDescriptions.spaceTotalScore: Weighted total SPACE score calculated from active dimension scores and metric weights.
metricDescriptions.mergedCount: Number of merge requests merged in the selected period. For a developer, this is MRs created by that developer and merged.
metricDescriptions.mergedLeadTimeHours: Average hours from MR creation to merge for MRs merged in the selected period. This uses the same MR set as merge count.
metricDescriptions.bugCausedCount: Number of bug issues attributed to this project or developer in the selected period.
metricDescriptions.bugFixLeadTimeHours: Average hours from bug issue creation to completion for fixed bugs in the selected period.
metricDescriptions.commitCount: Total commits in the selected period, filtered by project, branch, and developer when selected.
metricDescriptions.issueCreatedCount: Number of issues created in the selected period.
metricDescriptions.bugFoundCount: Number of bug issues found or reported in the selected period.
metricDescriptions.bugFixedCount: Number of bug issues completed or fixed in the selected period.
metricDescriptions.linesAdded: Total added lines from commits in the selected period.
metricDescriptions.linesDeleted: Total deleted lines from commits in the selected period.
metricDescriptions.linesTotal: Total changed lines from commits in the selected period. This is additions plus deletions.
metricDescriptions.reviewedCount: Review participation count. For a developer, this counts other people's MRs where they left an effective review comment in the selected period. For a project, this counts non-author reviewer participation on project MRs.
metricDescriptions.commentCount: Number of effective review comments posted on other people's MRs in the selected period. Author replies on their own MRs are not included.
metricDescriptions.reviewWaitTime: Average hours from MR creation to the first review comment.
metricDescriptions.uninterruptedFocusTimeHours: Average uninterrupted focus time per workday. Higher values indicate more time available for sustained deep work.
metricDescriptions.contextSwitchFrequency: Average number of switches between tasks, projects, or meetings per workday. Lower values indicate less fragmented work.
metricDescriptions.reviewCommentCount: Discussion density: average number of non-author review comments received per created MR. This is shown as context and is not directly used for scoring, because higher is not always better.
metricDescriptions.satisfactionSurveyScore: Average score from project satisfaction survey responses for the selected period.
metricDescriptions.satisfactionJobMeaning: Sub-score calculated from work value, meaningful work, team satisfaction, and recommendation intent.
metricDescriptions.satisfactionDeveloperEfficacy: Sub-score calculated from information access, development environment support, support flow, and confidence in outcomes.
metricDescriptions.satisfactionSustainability: Sub-score calculated from sustainable workload, fatigue, detachment, and excessive pressure. Negative questions are reverse-scored.
metricDescriptions.satisfactionImprovementPotential: Sub-score calculated from psychological safety and expectation that improvement suggestions can lead to real change.
metricDescriptions.satisfactionResponseCount: Number of satisfaction survey responses included in the selected period.

Space.performanceDescription: Evaluates the outcomes and quality produced by development work. Merged changes, developer-caused defects, and bug-fix speed indicate whether valuable results are delivered reliably.
Space.activityDescription: Evaluates the volume and continuity of development work through commits, issues, bug handling, and code changes. Activity is a proxy for work performed, not an outcome or quality measure by itself.
Space.communicationDescription: Evaluates collaboration and knowledge sharing through review participation, comments on others' merge requests, and constructive discussion during development.
Space.efficiencyDescription: Evaluates whether work flows smoothly with limited delays and interruptions. Merge lead time and review wait time show how efficiently changes reach completion.
Space.satisfactionDescription: Evaluates developer satisfaction and well-being through job meaning, developer efficacy, sustainability, and confidence that improvements can happen.

SatisfactionSurvey.title: Project Satisfaction Survey
SatisfactionSurvey.formDescription: Scores are collected per developer and reflected in that developer's SPACE Satisfaction dimension.
SatisfactionSurvey.commentPlaceholder: Add context, blockers, or improvement ideas.
SatisfactionSurvey.saveError: Failed to save the survey response.
SatisfactionSurvey.loadError: Failed to load satisfaction survey data.
SatisfactionSurvey.summaryDescription: Used as the selected developer's Satisfaction score when the selected period has responses.
SatisfactionSurvey.emptyHistory: No responses in the selected period.

q1WorkValue.title: Q1 Value delivered
q1WorkValue.description: My assigned work on the selected project felt valuable to the organization or users.

q2WorkMeaning.title: Q2 Meaningful work
q2WorkMeaning.description: I found my assigned work on the selected project motivating and worthwhile.

q3TeamSatisfaction.title: Q3 Team satisfaction
q3TeamSatisfaction.description: I was generally satisfied working on the selected project.

q4RecommendTeam.title: Q4 Recommend team
q4RecommendTeam.description: I could recommend the selected project as a development assignment to peers or junior colleagues.

q5InformationAccess.title: Q5 Information access
q5InformationAccess.description: I could access the specifications, design information, and domain knowledge needed for the selected project without major blockers.

q6EnvironmentSupport.title: Q6 Development environment
q6EnvironmentSupport.description: The development environment, GitLab, CI/CD, test environment, and IDE for the selected project sufficiently supported my work efficiency.

q7SupportFlow.title: Q7 Support flow
q7SupportFlow.description: When I had questions or technical issues on the selected project, the flow for consultation, confirmation, and resolution was appropriate.

q8OutcomeConfidence.title: Q8 Outcome confidence
q8OutcomeConfidence.description: I felt able to use my skills and experience to deliver the expected outcomes for the selected project.

q9SustainableWorkload.title: Q9 Sustainable workload
q9SustainableWorkload.description: My current workload on the selected project stayed within a sustainable range while maintaining quality.

q10Fatigue.title: Q10 Fatigue
q10Fatigue.description: I felt strong fatigue from work on the selected project that was hard to recover from.

q11Detachment.title: Q11 Detachment
q11Detachment.description: I felt psychological distance, helplessness, or a cooled-off feeling toward work on the selected project.

q12Pressure.title: Q12 Excessive pressure
q12Pressure.description: Deadline or quality pressure on the selected project made me work harder than would normally be sustainable.

q13PsychologicalSafety.title: Q13 Safety to raise issues
q13PsychologicalSafety.description: I could safely communicate productivity blockers on the selected project to my manager, lead, or team.

q14ImprovementExpectation.title: Q14 Improvement expectation
q14ImprovementExpectation.description: I felt that improvement suggestions about the selected project's process, tools, or work allocation could lead to real improvements.

DashboardTrends.title: Development flow over time
DashboardTrends.throughputDescription: Observe the volume and consistency of merged MRs. Longer ranges show daily averages.
DashboardTrends.leadTimeDescription: Time from MR creation to merge. Compare the mean and median together.
DashboardTrends.noLeadTime: No valid Merge Lead Time samples are available.
DashboardTrends.note: Commit and MR counts are daily totals. Lead Time connects valid observations by merge date; days without samples are not zero. Dots represent observed values.
DashboardTrends.groupedNote: Commit and MR counts are daily averages within each interval. Lead Time uses valid samples within each interval; intervals without samples are not zero. Dots represent observed values.
DashboardTrends.commitDescription: Observe development activity through commit counts. Longer ranges show daily averages.

Settings.aiModeDescription: When AI Mode is enabled, AI analyzes merge request code diffs and evaluates change type, complexity, maintainability, defect risk, and project contribution. The results are applied to SPACE metric corrections and used to provide strengths, risks, and integrated improvement recommendations across all five dimensions.
Settings.agentModelDescription: Used for Agent conversations. Free-tier availability depends on your Gemini API quota.

Settings.comparisonPeriodDescription: Choose the preceding period used by the dashboard comparison.
Settings.githubIntegrationDescription: Add a GitHub repository and analyze it with the existing SPACE scoring model.
